draftA:
Northwind Health
Attn: Appeals Department

Re: Appeal of Denial, Claim CLM-221
Patient: PAT-221
Date of Service: 2026-08-20
Service: MRI of the lumbar spine
Denial Code: CARC CO-50 (not deemed medically necessary)

To the Appeals Reviewer:

We are requesting reconsideration of the CO-50 denial for the lumbar spine MRI performed on 2026-08-20. This service was medically necessary and meets Northwind Health coverage policy LS-14.

Policy LS-14 covers a lumbar MRI after 6 weeks of documented conservative therapy. Clinical note DOC-318 documents the following conservative treatment:

- Physical therapy from 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-14, a period of just over six weeks.
- NSAIDs.
- No improvement with this treatment.

The MRI was performed on 2026-08-20, after the required six weeks of therapy had been completed and had failed. This satisfies the LS-14 criterion. The diagnosis code on the claim is unchanged.

We ask that you overturn the denial and process CLM-221 for payment. This appeal is submitted before the filing deadline of 2026-11-18.

Enclosures:
- Clinical note DOC-318
- Northwind Health policy LS-14 (cited)

Sincerely,

[Name]
[Title], Appeals Desk
[Practice name, phone, address]

reviewOfA.strengths: The letter correctly applies LS-14 to DOC-318’s therapy dates, NSAIDs, and lack of improvement, and every claim identifier, date, and the unchanged-diagnosis rule matches the record.

reviewOfB.strengths: The letter checks out against every fact: physical therapy from 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-14 spans 44 days, which meets LS-14's six-week requirement before the 2026-08-20 service. It also cites both the policy and DOC-318 as CO-50 requires, keeps the diagnosis code unchanged, and is concise plain text.
